snippets.text: At first conduct yourself with the modesty and demureness of a young maiden; but if the enemy shows you a small opening, then spring upon him with the liveliness of a rabbit—he will not be able to defend himself.
This non-fiction text analyzes the art of war of the Chinese generals Suntzu and Wutzu in a factual, historical tone.
The principles of these strategists endured for over 2500 years and had a lasting influence on both China and Japan.
A focused examination of military wisdom spanning from antiquity to the modern era.
Bruno Navarra was born in 1850 and died in 1911.
